test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In 2023, which repository is proposed to be set up in a digital epigraphy museum, with digitisation of one lakh ancient inscriptions in the first stage?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Shared Repository of Inscriptions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Bharat Shared Repository of Inscriptions (BSRI) is an initiative aimed at digitising ancient inscriptions across India.
 
• In its first phase, the project targets the digitisation of one lakh ancient inscriptions.
 
• The repository will be part of a digital epigraphy museum to preserve and share ancient Indian heritage.
 
• This initiative will help in the conservation, study, and promotion of India's rich epigraphical heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Epigraphy**

 
 
• Epigraphy is the study and interpretation of ancient inscriptions engraved on various materials like stone, metal, or pottery.
 
• It provides valuable insights into the language, culture, and history of ancient civilizations.
 
• Epigraphical records are primary historical sources that help in understanding the chronology and events of the past.
 
 
 
• **Digitisation of Inscriptions**
 
 
• Digitisation involves converting physical inscriptions into digital formats to ensure their preservation and accessibility.
 
• It helps in preventing the loss of historical data due to physical degradation over time.
 
• Digital repositories allow researchers and the public to access these inscriptions from anywhere in the world.
 
 
 
• **National Mission on Monuments and Antiquities**
 
 
• The National Mission on Monuments and Antiquities was launched by the Government of India to document and preserve India's heritage.
 
• It aims to create a comprehensive database of monuments and antiquities across the country.
 
• This mission plays a crucial role in protecting and promoting India's cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Digital Museums**
 
 
• Digital museums use technology to display and interpret cultural and historical artifacts.
 
• They provide an immersive experience to visitors through interactive exhibits and virtual tours.
 
• Digital museums help in reaching a wider audience and making heritage accessible to all.
